title: Giraffe holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M70 40 Q74 52 64 62' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='25' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c9'/>
  <polygon points='72,43 69,47 75,47' fill='#e0417a'/>
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='78' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='3.5' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='82' r='3.5' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='73' r='3' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='84' r='2.8' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='24' y='86' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e0a233'/>
  <rect x='33' y='87' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <rect x='44' y='86' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e0a233'/>
  <rect x='51' y='87' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M46 72 Q52 48 56 34 L64 36 Q60 52 56 74 Z' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='60' r='2.8' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='40' r='2.3' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='31' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#f7d08a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='30' r='1' fill='#a35a10'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <line x1='58' y1='23' x2='56' y2='16' stroke='#e0a233' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='22' x2='64' y2='15' stroke='#e0a233' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='15' r='2' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='14' r='2' fill='#c47b1e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='25' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e0a233' transform='rotate(-20 54 25)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='24' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e0a233' transform='rotate(15 69 24)'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='28' r='2.2' fill='#3b2a0f'/>
  <circle cx='63.7' cy='27.3' r='0.8' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <!-- raised front leg holding balloon -->
  <path d='M52 74 Q58 66 64 62' stroke='#f4b942' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='62' r='3' fill='#e0a233'/>
</svg>
